home.subtitle: How can we help your smile today?
home.noUpcomingHint: Book a visit with your dentist in a few taps.
home.linkBody: Already a patient at a clinic on ElDental? Link your file to see your appointments, plans and invoices here. The clinic will confirm it with a code sent to the phone they have on file.
home.tip: Brush twice a day for two minutes and book a check-up and cleaning every six months.

site.title: Your dental care, simplified
site.subtitle: Book appointments online, get reminders on WhatsApp, review your treatment plans and keep every invoice in one place — for you and your family.

b1.title: Book online, 24/7
b1.body: See real free times for your dentist and book in four simple steps — no phone calls.

b2.title: Reminders that help
b2.body: Get a WhatsApp or email reminder before every visit, and confirm with one tap.

b3.title: Understand your treatment
b3.body: Review your treatment plan, the cost estimate and insurance share, then accept it with your signature.

b4.title: Invoices & receipts
b4.body: Every invoice and receipt in one place, ready to download as a PDF.

b5.title: The whole family
b5.body: Parents can manage their children's appointments from the same account.

b6.title: Private & secure
b6.body: Your records are encrypted and only you and your clinic can see them.

h1.title: Create your account
h1.body: Your name and mobile number — we confirm it with a code.

h2.title: Link your clinic
h2.body: Connect the file your clinic already has for you.

h3.title: Book and relax
h3.body: Pick a time, get reminders and arrive ready.

site.ctaBody: Create your free patient account in under a minute.
